snippet.title: Misha Official Trailer
snippet.description:
December 23rd. It’s almost time for Christmas.

You play as Helen, spending a quiet evening at home with her sweet calico cat, Misha. What begins as an ordinary evening—warm lights, gentle cuddles, soft meows—might not stay that way.

Misha is a short visual novel experience about everyday interactions and the choices woven into them. You shape how the evening unfolds—often in ways you might not expect.

Wishlist Misha on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4559470/Misha/

✨ Features

🐾 A 10–20 minute emotionally driven experience with multiple outcomes

🎭 A focus on small, everyday decisions

🎨 Handcrafted visuals and intimate storytelling

🎙️ Fully voice-acted

🐱 Features a cat

#misha #visualnovel #indie #indiegame #cute #cat 
#parallelplay #thecoolnoob
